title: Touch input
summary: Samples caller-supplied pointer controls and namespaced actions; retains the editable flight overlay and its styles.

blocks.text: This module translates pointer gestures on caller-supplied HTML elements into namespaced action values for active local player seats (pilots 0–3). It provides the input.touch service through the TOUCH_INPUT key. It tracks hold buttons, horizontal axes (axis-x), and vertical axes (axis-y) using Pointer Events and pointer capture, clamping axis values to [-1, 1]. It also provides createFlight to instantiate the legacy TouchControlsManager flight overlay, with visibility preferences saved under storage key space-sim:touch-controls:v1. It does not advance simulation time or step physics worlds.

items: Provides input.touch@1.0.0 through the TOUCH_INPUT key: pointer gesture input source factory and flight touch overlay manager.
The module itself requires no services.
Initialization registers the TOUCH_INPUT service and tracks all active sources and managers for automatic disposal. The module creates no DOM elements until requested.
create attaches pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup, pointercancel, and lostpointercapture listeners across up to 256 caller-supplied elements.

sample evaluates active gestures for the assigned pilot, writing active values in [-1, 1] into the action sink. Continuous gestures emit updated fractions; press gestures pulse once on initial contact.
Window blur, pagehide, document hiding, or pilot seat changes immediately release active pointer captures and reset gesture values to zero.
dispose removes all element and window event listeners. Provider disposal releases all created sources and overlay managers, throwing an AggregateError if cleanup fails.

blocks.text: Games without touch devices or pointer-based on-screen controls can omit this module. To replace it, build a platform-tier module providing input.touch@1.0.0.

Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze: pointer gesture definitions and overlay manager contracts may change before API freeze. Flight touch settings persist under storage key space-sim:touch-controls:v1.

examples/modules/input-touch is a consumer module that uses input.touch@1.0.0 to configure custom touch controls over mock elements and sample pointer gestures. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/input-touch/module.json /tmp/input-touch-example.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/input-touch-example.spacemod
